title: When To Refactor vs. Rewrite
description:
Every engineering team faces the same crossroads: refactor the old system—or rewrite it from scratch?
The right call depends on risk, timeline, and the true cost of complexity.
We break down a pragmatic checklist to decide with confidence and avoid costly detours.

title: Shipping Faster Without Breaking Things
description:
Speed and stability aren’t enemies.
With the right guardrails—feature flags, trunk-based development, and contract testing—teams can move quickly and safely.
Here’s how high-performing teams ship continuously without turning every release into a fire drill.
